narr: A weak push of monsoon moisture plus ongoing record heat fueled a few thunderstorms which produced flash flooding in Death Valley National Park.
ev: Rocks were washed onto Hwy 190 at Towne Pass.
Water, mud, debris, and rocks closed Hwy 190 between mile markers 110 and 115 with about 20 vehicles unable to get through. The entry road to The Inn was washed out.
lsr: ROCKS REPORTED ON HIGHWAY FROM RAIN AND FLOODING IN THE AREA. REPORTED BY CHP AND TIME ESTIMATED FROM RADAR.
